title: wicket:head
text: Wraps content that a panel, border or page contributes to the <head> of the page: <style>, <script>, <meta> and similar. Place it outside <wicket:panel>, <wicke
body: Wraps content that a panel, border or page contributes to the <head> of the page: <style>, <script>, <meta> and similar. Place it outside <wicket:panel>, <wicket:border> and <wicket:extend>; inside them, Wicket throws Mis-placed <wicket:head>. Attribute Required Meaning wicket:scope no A name that groups head sections when Wicket decides whether a section was already written. Rarely needed. The content is written once per component class, however many instances of the component are on the page. With markup inheritance, the <wicket:head> sections of the parent and the subclass are both included. AddressPanel.html <wicket:head> <style>.address { font-style: normal; }</style> </wicket:head> <wicket:panel> <address class="address" wicket:id="text"></address> </wicket:panel> For CSS and JavaScript files, contributing from Java is more flexible; see Add CSS and JavaScript to a page.

title: wicket:header-items

body: Marks the place inside a page’s <head> where Wicket writes all header contributions, from Java and from <wicket:head>. Without it they go at the end of <head>. Use it when your own tags must come before or after Wicket’s. Attributes: none. Allowed only inside the page’s <head>, at most once. <head> <meta charset="UTF-8"> <wicket:header-items/> <script src="patch-after-wicket.js"></script> </head> See Control the order of header items.

text: Attaches the tag to the Java component with the same id. Wicket looks for the component among the children of the container whose markup holds the tag, followin
body:
Attaches the tag to the Java component with the same id. Wicket looks for the component among the children of the container whose markup holds the tag, following the nesting of the HTML. Rule Detail Value The component id. Must not be empty and must not contain : or ~. Uniqueness Unique among the children of one container. The same id can appear under different parents. Tag without component Rendering fails with Unable to find component with id '...'. Component without tag Rendering fails in development mode with The component(s) below failed to render. HomePage.html

Placeholder title

HomePage.java add(new Label("title", "Welcome")); The body of the tag is replaced by whatever the component renders. For a Label, the placeholder text disappears.

title: wicket:label
text: Writes the label text of a form component. It looks for the text in this order: the component’s label model, the resource key Wicket uses for the component’s la
body: Writes the label text of a form component. It looks for the text in this order: the component’s label model, the resource key Wicket uses for the component’s label, the resource named by key, and finally its own body. When the body is used, it becomes the component’s label, so validation messages use it too. Attribute Required Meaning for outside a wicket:for label Id or path of the form component key no Resource key to use when the component has no label escape no false writes the label without escaping. Default: escaped. Accepts true/false, on/off, yes/no, y/n, 1/0. <label wicket:for="email"><wicket:label>Email address</wicket:label></label> <input type="email" wicket:id="email"> <wicket:label for="phone" key="phone.label"/>

body: Turns links and resource references inside it into Wicket links, without Java code. Attribute Required Meaning autolink no false turns automatic linking off inside the tag. Default: true. Inside the tag, Wicket handles every element without a wicket:id whose href or src holds no : (so no https: or mailto: URLs): Element Attribute Result href ending in .html A link to the page class with that name, relative to the package of the current page, or absolute such as /com/example/HomePage.html. body: Inserts a text from the resource bundles, or puts localized texts into attribute values. See Translate component texts for where the texts come from. As a tag Attribute Required Meaning key yes The resource key escape no true escapes the text for HTML. Default: the text is written as is. Hello The tag body is preview content and is replaced by the text. When the key is missing, Wicket throws an exception. With ResourceSettings#setThrowExceptionOnMissingResource(false) it logs a warning and renders the body instead. Components nested in the tag are rendered into the text in place of ${id} variables: balance=Your balance is ${amount}. Click ${details} for the details. here=here As an attribute Sets attributes of the tag it is on to localized texts. The value is a comma-separated list of attribute:key pairs. An existing value of the attribute is the default when the key is missing.

title: WicketTester
text: The methods of WicketTester, grouped by purpose, with FormTester, TagTester and the JUnit helpers of the wicket-tester module.
keywords: wicket-tester assert methods startPage clickLink executeAjaxEvent assertLabel assertErrorMessages executeTest expected result JUnit 5 test helper

body: WicketTester, in the wicket-tester module, runs a Wicket application in memory with a mock servlet container. It processes requests synchronously on the calling thread and keeps the last rendered page, request and response. WicketTester adds JUnit assertions to BaseWicketTester, which holds the machinery. Component paths in all methods are relative to the page, with ids separated by :. Test pages and components shows them in use.

body: Each assert method fails the test with a message. body: Class Description WicketTesterExtension JUnit 5 extension that creates a tester before each test and destroys it afterwards. Override create() to build it with your application; register it with @RegisterExtension and get the tester with getTester(). WicketTestCase Abstract base class with a public tester field, created before and destroyed after each test. Override newApplication() or newWicketTester(WebApplication) to change it. Also offers executeTest and markup comparison helpers. class HomePageTest { @RegisterExtension WicketTesterExtension wicket = new WicketTesterExtension() { @Override protected WicketTester create() { return new WicketTester(new WicketApplication()); } }; @Test void rendersSuccessfully() { wicket.getTester().startPage(HomePage.class); wicket.getTester().assertRenderedPage(HomePage.class); } }

title: WicketStuff
text: The community modules of the WicketStuff project, what each one adds to Wicket, and how to add one to a Maven build.
keywords: community components third party modules extensions add-ons wicketstuff-core jQuery UI Kendo UI Select2 TinyMCE Google Maps REST Shiro page store Redis Hazelcast Excel export
body: WicketStuff is a collection of Wicket modules written and maintained by the Wicket community, outside the Apache Wicket project. The sources, issue tracker and wiki are at github.com/wicketstuff/core. Most modules come with an examples project next to them in the repository.

title: Add a module
text: The modules have the group id org.wicketstuff. WicketStuff releases follow the version numbers of Wicket: use the WicketStuff release with the same major versio
body: The modules have the group id org.wicketstuff. WicketStuff releases follow the version numbers of Wicket: use the WicketStuff release with the same major version as your Wicket release. <dependency> <groupId>org.wicketstuff</groupId> <artifactId>wicketstuff-select2</artifactId> <version>${wicketstuff.version}</version> </dependency> To keep the versions of several modules in line, import the BOM: <dependencyManagement> <dependencies> <dependency> <groupId>org.wicketstuff</groupId> <artifactId>wicketstuff-bom</artifactId> <version>${wicketstuff.version}</version> <type>pom</type> <scope>import</scope> </dependency> </dependencies> </dependencyManagement> WicketStuff follows Wicket’s releases after they appear. When you move to a new major version of Wicket, check that the modules you use have been released for it.

JavaScript widgets Artifact Adds wicketstuff-jquery-ui, wicketstuff-jquery-ui-plugins, wicketstuff-jquery-ui-calendar Components and behaviors for jQuery UI widgets: dialogs, date pickers, autocomplete, sliders, tabs, a calendar. wicketstuff-kendo-ui Components for Kendo UI widgets, from the same project as jQuery UI. wicketstuff-select2 Select boxes with search, tagging and Ajax loading of options, based on Select2. wicketstuff-selectize Select boxes based on Selectize. wicketstuff-autocomplete-tagit Tag input with autocompletion, based on Tag-it. wicketstuff-tinymce6 WYSIWYG HTML editing for text areas with TinyMCE 6, through TinyMceBehavior. wicketstuff-datatables Tables based on the DataTables jQuery plugin. wicketstuff-clipboardjs Copy text to the clipboard with clipboard.js. wicketstuff-input-events Bind keyboard shortcuts and other input events to components. modalx Base classes for modal windows and modal forms. wicketstuff-progressbar A progress bar for long-running tasks. Maps and charts Artifact Adds wicketstuff-gmap3 Google Maps with the GMap component. wicketstuff-openlayers3 Interactive maps with OpenLayers. jqplot Charts with jqPlot. wicketstuff-flot Charts with Flot. Grids and data Artifact Adds wicketstuff-inmethod-grid DataGrid and TreeGrid: grids with resizable and reorderable columns, selection and inline editing. wicketstuff-editable-grid A data table whose rows can be edited, added and deleted in place. wicketstuff-poi Export tables to Excel with Apache POI. wicketstuff-jasperreports Render JasperReports reports as resources. wicketstuff-dashboard-core, wicketstuff-dashboard-widgets A dashboard of movable widgets. Application infrastructure Artifact Adds wicketstuff-annotation Mount pages with the @MountPath annotation instead of mountPage() calls. wicketstuff-restannotations, wicketstuff-restannotations-json REST APIs as Wicket resources, with methods mapped by annotations. wicketstuff-rest-lambda REST endpoints defined with lambdas. wicketstuff-lambda-components Factory methods that create links and buttons from lambdas. wicketstuff-lazymodel Type-safe property models checked by the compiler. wicketstuff-urlfragment Read and write parameters in the URL fragment, for bookmarkable Ajax state. wicketstuff-sitemap-xml Generate sitemap.xml files for search engines. wicketstuff-htmlcompressor Compress the rendered markup with htmlcompressor. wicketstuff-annotationeventdispatcher Deliver Wicket events to methods marked with an annotation. wicketstuff-mbeanview A panel that shows and operates the application’s JMX MBeans. Integration, security and storage Artifact Adds wicketstuff-javaee-inject Inject EJBs, JNDI resources and persistence units; see Inject EJBs. wicketstuff-springreference A serializable reference to Spring beans, for places where @SpringBean does not work. wicketstuff-shiro Authentication and authorization with Apache Shiro. wicketstuff-datastore-redis, -hazelcast, -cassandra, -memcached, -ignite Page stores that keep pages in a shared data store, for clusters. See Configure the page store. wicketstuff-serializer-fast2 A faster page serializer based on FST. wicketstuff-serializer-kryo2 A page serializer based on Kryo. Its own documentation advises against production use.
